race.comment: REVENGEANCE (1) Golden Gift winner last year and ready to peak third up. Held up in traffic and should have finished closer when sixth in the G2 Run To The Rose over 1200m at this track. Kept fresh and can stalk the good speed. OUTSPAN (3) frustrating colt who gets the lugging bit added today. Just under a month between runs when he launched late to run third in the G3 Heritage Stakes over 1100m here. No problem with the trip and look for him pinching runs along the inside. PLAGIARISM (2) drops a few grades today after he failed to sustain the fast pace with a tiring seventh over 1400m in the G1 Golden Rose Stakes. Assess on the win here three back and stays in the mix. CHUCHICHASCHTLI (11) kept safe in betting on debut with a slick win along the inside over 1200m in a Super Maiden at Warwick Farm. Thrown in the deep end here and can give this a real shake. PIEDMONT (10) caught the eye when fourth in the G3 Ming Dynasty over this track and trip. Since fitted with a 795m trial. Respect.
